machine.telemetry_api: macOS XNU proc_pid_rusage(RUSAGE_INFO_V6) -> ri_energy_nj, ri_instructions, ri_cycles
machine.measurement_scope: Per-process Apple Silicon CPU core & kernel-attributed hardware PMU energy (ri_energy_nj / ri_penergy_nj), retired instructions, CPU cycles, and OS disk I/O bytes. Excludes off-package SSD controller rail, external DRAM rail, and AC wall-socket power.

powermetrics_probe.soc_backend_used: macOS libIOReport.dylib 'Energy Model' (325 channels; same hardware accumulator backend as powermetrics)

exposed_soc_rails.cpu_complex: CPU Energy (mJ; covers EACC + PACC0 + PACC1 cores, SRAM, CPM)
exposed_soc_rails.memory_and_fabric: DRAM0 (mJ) + DCS0 (mJ, DRAM controller) + AMCC0 (mJ, Apple Memory Cache Controller)
exposed_soc_rails.display_media_io: DISP0, DISPEXT0, ISP0, AVE0, MSR0, PCIe Port *, apciec*
exposed_soc_rails.explicitly_unmeasured: Wall-plug AC power, AC/DC adapter conversion loss, display panel backlight, discrete SSD NAND flash rail, cooling fans, and battery charging circuit.
